assumptions.goalDistribution: independent Poisson with mildly shrunk recency-weighted scoring/conceding rates
assumptions.leagueGoalBaseline: current date-qualified prior match snapshots in research base
assumptions.xgAndShots: only verified matched team stats; xG absent for most fixtures
assumptions.h2h: 3% blend when at least three verified prior meetings
assumptions.standingsStrength: ESPN season table PPG and goal difference, sample-size damped, capped goal rate adjustment
assumptions.scope: men only, all archived league fixtures

note: Each result is a Monte Carlo simulation count, not independently validated or calibrated betting confidence. Backtests needed before production picks or price comparisons.
